title: Enterprise GPU Sharing & Tidal Colocation Selection: Hardware MIG vs. CUDA MPS vs. Time-Slicing vs. HAMi/Kueue Tidal Benchmark

workload_assumptions.workload_mix: Small Embedding/Rerank/SLM (0.6B-8B) + Diurnal 70B Serving + Nightly Batch/SFT

tiers.name: Tier 1: 1 Whole H200 per Small Model (Embedding/Reranker) & Static Siloed Online/Offline Pools
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: Allocating a 141GB H200 to a 2GB Embedding model wastes 94% HBM; 60% of fleet idles at night

tiers.name: Tier 2: K8s Time-Slicing Oversubscription (4 Pods Share 1 GPU Without HBM Limits or Fault Isolation)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern for Production: 1 bursty tenant triggers CUDA OOM for all 4 colocated pods; 48.6ms switch jitter

tiers.name: Tier 3: Hardware MIG (`1g.18gb / 3g.71gb`) for Multi-Tenant Isolation + CUDA MPS for Same-Tenant Pipelines
tiers.verdict: 0.0% cross-tenant fault/jitter via hardware MIG + 11.4ms MPS fusion, but night-time online GPUs still sit idle

tiers.name: Tier 4: MIG (Multi-Tenant) + MPS (Same-Tenant RAG) + Kueue Tidal Colocation (`vLLM Sleep level=1` Night Harvest)
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 89.2% 24h cluster utilization (3.38x vs. Tier 1), 0.0% SLA breach & -66.5% monthly TCO
